items.title: Warren Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995
items.q: thanks to Bucky Pizzarelli and Kenny Davern... I was cast as Bix for a day... Bucky Pizzarelli recommended me... I did my first overseas trip in 1974 with Benny and John Bunch and Bucky Pizzarelli

ctx.x: Was one of your first big moments — this is something I read and I don’t know if it’s true — you did a concert with the New York Jazz Repertory and you were doing some Bix tunes or something?

Yeah, that was the first concert I really did in New York was for the New York Jazz Repertory Company, and it was the music of Bix Beiderbecke and thanks to Bucky Pizzarelli and Kenny Davern, and some very timely recommendations, I was cast as Bix for a day.
Did you do a lot of listening before that, or was it already a part of you?
